artworks.title: Midas Washing at the Source of the Pactolus
artworks.description: Poussin shows Midas plunging in the river by Sardis — the golden curse washed away after bread and wine turned metal in his hands.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Midas
artworks.description: Crespi's contest on Tmolus — Pan's pipes against Apollo's lyre, and the ass's ears Midas earned for his judgment.
